# ARWP Search + AI Visibility Recommendations

> A dated, source-backed implementation playbook for making public websites easier to discover, retrieve, cite and operate across classic search, Google generative Search, ChatGPT Search, Bing/Copilot and browser agents.

Reviewed: `2026-09-06`
Registry version: `0.2`
Rules: `34`

ARWP does not promise crawling, indexing, ranking, rich results, AI citation or agent success. Requirements, opportunities, measurements and experiments remain separate.

## Start here

- [Search & AI Visibility Playbook](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/recommendations/): Human guide, implementation packs and searchable rule catalog.
- [Machine-readable registry](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/recommendations/registry.json): Current rules, actions, verification steps, priorities, maturity and primary sources.
- [Page Semantics Profile](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/recommendations/page-semantics.json): Route-aware structured-data and entity guidance.
- [Ruleset history](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/recommendations/history/index.json): Immutable dated snapshots.
- [Growth loop](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/growth/): Baseline, hypotheses, remediation, owner evidence and experiment review.

## Recommended order

1. Search eligibility: crawl access, HTTP 200, indexability and snippet eligibility.
2. Internal discovery: crawlable links to every priority page.
3. URL consistency: canonical, redirects, sitemap and localized variants agree.
4. Renderability: important content and links remain available as text/rendered HTML.
5. Content value: first-hand evidence, data, examples, experience or a distinct conclusion.
6. Citation structure: clear sections, stable anchors, factual parity and supporting evidence.
7. Media: relevant large images, useful alt/context and discoverable video surfaces when appropriate.
8. Identity/provenance: real authors, stable profiles, dataset identifiers/licenses and grounded software/product facts.
9. Platform-specific mechanisms: OAI-SearchBot, Preferred Sources, IndexNow, local/commerce owner data.
10. Measurement: Google generative-AI Search Console views, Bing AI Performance and ChatGPT referral analytics.
11. Agent experiments: ARIA/Atlas compatibility, WebMCP runtime evals and emerging protocol watch items.

## High-signal 2026 updates

### Google generative Search

Google's current guidance says normal SEO foundations remain the basis for AI Overviews and AI Mode. No special AI-only schema or machine-readable file is required. The 2026 guidance emphasizes useful non-commodity content, clear sections/headings, crawlability, textual content, images/video and normal technical Search practices.

Google Search Console now provides dedicated generative-AI performance views for Search and Discover; Google states the rollout reached all websites worldwide on 31 August 2026.

### ChatGPT Search and Atlas

OpenAI documents separate controls for OAI-SearchBot discovery and GPTBot training. ChatGPT referral URLs include `utm_source=chatgpt.com`, which can be measured in first-party analytics.

OpenAI also documents that ChatGPT Agent in Atlas uses ARIA labels and roles to understand interactive page structure. ARWP therefore treats accessibility semantics as both an accessibility requirement and an agent-compatibility surface, without replacing native HTML or runtime testing.

### Bing and Copilot

Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance is in public preview and exposes citation activity for supported Microsoft AI experiences. Bing recommends clear headings/tables/FAQ where useful, evidence-supported claims, freshness and consistency across text, images and video.

### Agent web

WebMCP remains a Chrome origin-trial mechanism and requires browser-runtime evaluation and security review. IETF AIPREF Content-Usage and the W3C Introduction Layer remain watch/experimental items rather than stable ranking requirements.

## Implementation packs

- `search-foundation`: eligibility, internal links, canonical consistency, rendering, text and sitemap freshness.
- `ai-citation`: AI eligibility, original evidence, clear sections, deep links, structured-data parity and Bing citation clarity.
- `freshness`: truthful `lastmod` plus bounded IndexNow use.
- `identity-provenance`: authors, profile identity, Dataset and SoftwareApplication where real.
- `media-discover`: Discover images, image context/alt and video discovery.
- `international`: real localized variants with reciprocal hreflang.
- `local-commerce`: Google owner data plus Bing Places where applicable.
- `chatgpt`: OAI-SearchBot, referral measurement and ARIA/Atlas compatibility.
- `measurement`: Google, Bing and ChatGPT owner-side evidence.
- `agent-experiments`: WebMCP, AIPREF, W3C Introduction Layer and ARWP runtime truth.
- `anti-cargo-cult`: no query-variant page factories, fake facts or speculative ranking claims.

## Repository-agent remediation model

`problem → evidence → risk → recommendedChange → files → autofix → verification → source`

Autofix requires grounded first-party facts. Missing authorship, biography, organization/legal facts, event details, price, availability, rating/review data, dataset identifiers/licenses or publication history must not be invented.

The intended loop is:

`baseline → choose a bounded pack → patch → build/render → verify → collect owner evidence → compare → keep/revise/revert`

## Evidence semantics

- `pass` / `fail`: directly observable checks with bounded evidence.
- `warn`: heuristic issue or optional opportunity worth review.
- `observed`: a draft/experimental signal was actually present.
- `not-assessed`: needs route-wide review, manual judgment, authenticated owner data or browser runtime.
- `not-applicable`: optional mechanism does not apply.
- `watch`: upstream work is still incubating.

## CLI

```text
arwp audit https://example.com --json
arwp-growth https://example.com --json
arwp-visibility compare before.json after.json
arwp-agent-eval show agent-eval.json
arwp-indexnow payload https://example.com --urls-file=changed-urls.txt
```

## Maintenance

Scheduled source watchers track upstream changes. Reachability alone never changes a recommendation. Material source changes require review and a new dated snapshot; prior snapshots remain immutable.
